messages:
maria: Heads up — invoice previews are showing ~+30% token usage for a subset of small tenants since yesterday's deploy. Not seeing matching spikes in production traces. Anyone on metering side?
kevin: @maria can you paste the preview diff or a sample tenant id?
sophie: We shipped the compact-agg-window and ttl-snapshot change last night (PR #8212). That could affect hourly joins on tally.
maria: sample tenant: tenant_9f2b, preview before/after attached (screenshot). Quick query I ran: 
```
SELECT hour, SUM(tokens) FROM tally_agg WHERE tenant_id='tenant_9f2b' AND hour >= '2026-03-18' GROUP BY hour;
```
kevin: Hmm, query looks normal. Do you have the raw event counts? If aggregate window got bigger we'd expect counts to shift, but +30% seems large.
ingest-bot: alert: metering.ingest.fanout.latency spike at 2026-03-18T23:10Z (+2.3s) — related consumer: tally-finalizer-2
alex: tagging in case: could be double-counting from a new dedupe TTL regression. We changed TTL snapshot retention from 1h -> 3h in the migration to reduce tail misses.
sophie: yeah that was the change. Rationale was to avoid split-session attr misses for long-running streams. Might have accidentally kept overlapping windows for compact aggregation too.
maria: logs show duplicate fingerprint acceptance for a few sessions across hour boundaries. snippet: 
```
2026-03-18T23:09:41Z INFO accept_fingerprint tenant=tenant_9f2b fp=abc123 session=...
2026-03-18T23:09:42Z INFO accept_fingerprint tenant=tenant_9f2b fp=abc123 session=...
```
kevin: if dedupe window extended we might be re-incorporating events during finalizer reruns. Two approaches: revert TTL to 1h now (fast) or deploy a patch that dedupes by (fingerprint, finalized_window_start) (safer). Thoughts?
alex: revert + hotfix seems pragmatic for SLO. We'll need a backfill to reconcile previews for affected tenants if we revert.
sophie: agree on revert. I'll open an emergency PR to flip TTL back and include a migration note. Also add a canary that checks invoice-preview delta per-tenant before/after.
maria: UX note — console is showing these previews without any flag. We should tag preview numbers with "estimated (post-deploy drift)" when a metering rollout touches tally or TTL windows. Non-technical PMs are already pinging billing.
kevin: Agreed. Short-term: add a banner on invoice preview page and a toggle to hide previews until recon is done. Longer-term: console should display a metering-rollout attribution timeline (which rollout touched tally schemas/ttl).\sophie: I opened temp PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/8340 — includes revert + telemetry emitted: `metering.rollback_hint=true` for affected commits. Also adds a small reconciliation job that computes per-tenant delta and emits to observability.
ingest-bot: notice: reconciliation job queued for 100 tenants, ETA 22m.
maria: thanks team. Action items: Sophie revert now, Kevin coordinate backfill vs finance for accounting windows, Alex draft rollback postmortem blurb, I'll add console banner (PR coming). :thumbsup:
kevin: cc @finance for heads-up. Will follow up on reconciliation output. :eyes:
alex: will prepare the rollback runbook (steps + smoke tests).
maria: moving to #release-war-room after revert, will post timestamps.
kevin: moving to monitor channel.
